description: Decode steps of one DeepSeek-V4-Pro CSA layer at TP8 (sgl-amd-mono monokernel widths 1, 4 and 8 rows; one request a row). Contexts are AgentX (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126, decode-step weighted, context = in + out / 2) quantiles: p10 52K, p25 108K, p50 220K, p75 426K, p90 632K and the corpus maximum 990K, below the kernel's 1M cap; derived from corpus statistics, not yet confirmed by a live capture. Other rows of a step decode at contexts drawn in [ctx / 2, ctx]. Short contexts (up to 4K, 4.4% of decode steps), the 1025-entry indexer threshold, mixed below/above-threshold batches and the 1M cap are correctness-only.

cases.source: minimum: first decode step of a request (no compressed entry, 2 window keys)
short contexts (AgentX <= 4K bucket, 4.4% of decode steps), all compressed entries attended
first context past the indexer threshold: top-1024 of 1025 live entries
a batch mixing rows below (all entries) and above (top-1024) the indexer threshold
the kernel's context cap (SGLang DeepSeek-V4 MAX_CONTEXT 2^20)

AgentX decode-weighted context p50 (220K), single request
AgentX decode-weighted context p90 (632K), single request
